response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, stanza beginning “Then, a rich voice…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"Then, a rich voice spoke inside me,","suggested_fix":"Replace “Kisha sauti yenye utajiri ikasema ndani yangu,” with “Kisha sauti yenye mamlaka ikasema ndani yangu,” to convey a voice rich in quality or depth, not material wealth.","translation_quote":"Kisha sauti yenye utajiri ikasema ndani yangu,"},{"location":"HTML, stanza beginning “But I saw that your heart needed different…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"But I saw that your heart needed different / Than the way that ease had preferred.","suggested_fix":"Replace the two lines with “Lakini niliona kwamba moyo wako ulihitaji kitu tofauti / na kile ambacho maisha ya raha yangependelea.” The current wording shifts the contrast to “easy life” and leaves the comparison unclear.","translation_quote":"Lakini niliona moyo wako ulihitaji kitu tofauti / Na kile ambacho maisha mepesi yangependelea."},{"location":"HTML, stanza beginning “I pray that my heart would be yielded…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"Allowing His will to change me,","suggested_fix":"Replace “Nikiruhusu mapenzi yake yanibadilishe,” with “Nikiacha mapenzi yake yanibadilishe,” to preserve the sense of yielding to and allowing the Master’s will to change the speaker.","translation_quote":"Nikiruhusu mapenzi yake yanibadilishe,"},{"location":"HTML, final stanza","severity":"major","source_quote":"If He rules the inmost being, / Then nothing outside will disturb.","suggested_fix":"Replace “Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachotusumbua.” with “Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachonisumbua.” The source speaks about the individual speaker, not “us.”","translation_quote":"Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachotusumbua."}],"passed":false,"score":88}
